title: Director Of Product, Onboarding, Hardware & Supply Chain
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
 Toast’s Customer onboarding, hardware orders and inventory flows run on business systems that our Supply Chain, Finance, Care, and Onboarding teams rely on every day. As Director of Product – Onboarding, Hardware & Supply Chain Systems , you will own the vision, roadmap, and outcomes for those systems as part of the Business Technology & Transformation (BTT) organization. You will lead a team of product managers and BSAs while acting as a strategic product partner to leaders in Supply Chain, Finance, Accounting, Care, Onboarding, and Customer Success Operations. You’ll also work hand in hand with upstream and downstream BTT teams and R&D, so data and processes flow cleanly end to end across Salesforce, NetSuite, and the platforms between them and deliver scalable, high-impact solutions that support Toast’s exponential growth.
 A day in the life (Responsibilities)  
 Strategy & Leadership 
 Set the multi-year vision and roadmap for Onboarding, Hardware & Supply Chain systems, tied to company strategy and the priorities of Supply Chain, Finance, Care, and Onboarding leaders.
 Build, coach, and grow a high-performing team of product managers and analysts including hiring, career development, and clear accountability for outcomes.
 Partner with senior Supply Chain, Finance, Care, Onboarding, and Technology leadership to translate business needs into scalable system solutions.
 Work with upstream and downstream BTT teams and R&D to align roadmaps, manage cross-team dependencies, and agree on who owns data and integrations across systems.
 Establish the team’s product operating model: how work is in-taken, prioritized, planned, and communicated, using outcome-based goals (e.g., OKRs).
 Drive strategy to build scalable processes that power and support exponential growth in hardware, supply chain, and customer support operations.
 Product Ownership 
 Own the hardware order experience from order to fulfilment, inventory-related supply chain systems, 3PLs, Onboarding systems, and key master data infrastructure.
 Maintain and manage the project funnel, driving prioritization across multiple functional streams spanning operational improvements and strategic initiatives.
 Own and deliver outcomes for high-impact strategic initiatives from discovery and design through launch, adoption, and measured business results.
 Drive enhancements, integrations, and automation to improve efficiency, accuracy, and user experience across Salesforce, Netsuite and related platforms.
 Ensure successful adoption: releases are communicated, users are trained, and usage is tracked.
 Implementation & Optimization 
 Lead evaluation and implementation of new supply chain, hardware, and customer support technologies and tools, including Salesforce, NetSuite and platform integrations across business and engineering systems; making clear build vs. buy vs. configure recommendations.
 Oversee integrations across enterprise platforms (Finance, Accounting, Care, Onboarding, data warehouse, and related systems).
 Organize ambiguous ideas and targets into detailed functional requirements, providing point-of-view feedback on prioritization and criticality based on deep business understanding.
 Lead delivery of large implementations, migrations, and enhancements, managing scope, risk, and cross-team dependencies from design through rollout.
 Stakeholder Engagement 
 Act as a trusted advisor to Supply Chain, Finance, Accounting, Care, Onboarding, and Customer Success Operations leaders; bringing a clear point of view on priorities, trade-offs, and what’s technically feasible.
 Build strong working relationships with engineering, R&D, and BTT partners to resolve cross-team dependencies and keep delivery moving.
 Communicate roadmap, progress, and risks clearly to executives and stakeholders at the right level of detail, in both business and technical terms.
 Translate business requirements into clear, actionable functional and technical specifications, and facilitate timely decision-making across a broad network of stakeholders.
 Gather regular feedback from the people who use these systems (Care agents, Onboarding consultants, Supply Chain and Finance users) and use it to guide improvements.
 Performance & Risk Management 
 Establish KPIs to track system adoption, stability, efficiency, and business results achieved through solution implementation (for example, order accuracy, on-time hardware delivery, inventory discrepancy rate, and time to onboard).
 Proactively identify and manage risks in hardware, supply chain, Onboarding and customer support systems with clear mitigation plans and escalation paths.
 Apply root cause analysis and systems design methodologies to resolve inventory discrepancies, hardware delivery failures, and process gaps, using a data-driven approach to problem-solving.
 What you'll need to thrive (Requirements) 
 10+ years of experience in Product Management, Business systems, or Supply Chain/Enterprise Systems, including system implementation, platform integration, and transformation.
 5+ years in leadership roles with proven ability to build and lead high-performing teams.
 Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, TMS/3PLs and Order Management systems required.
 Demonstrated skill in systems analysis, including root cause analysis and process modeling/systems design methodologies.
 Proven experience driving large-scale supply chain, hardware, or enterprise system implementations, migrations, or enhancements.
 Proficient in how applications share data and communicate; expert in how data flows across systems, with the ability to articulate simple and accurate solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Program Manager, Digital Customer Success
salary_text: $127K – $149K • Offers Equity • This role is also eligible for medical benefits, 401(k) plan, and other company perk programs.
description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Vanta is looking for a Program Manager to build and scale digital-first customer experiences that accelerate onboarding, product activation, and ongoing adoption. You’ll turn customer insights, product usage data, automation, and AI into programs that help early-stage and mid-market customers realize value and support retention and growth.




THE TEAM

The Digital Success Programs team creates scalable, personalized customer experiences that extend the reach of Customer Success. The team partners across Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Education, Community, Data, and Operations to deliver measurable customer outcomes through digital engagement, education, automation, and community programs.




THE ROLE

As a Program Manager on the Digital Success Programs team, you’ll own programs across the customer lifecycle and help translate product priorities and customer needs into repeatable, measurable engagement. It is a builder role for someone who can combine program management, customer empathy, data fluency, with strong cross-functional execution.




WHAT YOU’LL DO AS A PROGRAM MANAGER AT VANTA

 - Own one or more digital customer success programs end to end, such as cohort onboarding and one-to-many activation programs that integrate education and community engagement.

 - Design, build, and optimize scalable email communications across onboarding, activation, and adoption stages, using customer attributes, product usage signals, and behavioral triggers.

 - Partner with Customer Success, Product, Education, Marketing, and Community to tailor programs to customer segments, adoption milestones, and risk signals.

 - Measure program performance against onboarding, activation, engagement, and time-to-value goals, and continuously improve program outcomes.

 - Partner on activation strategy and own digital program execution for product launches and strategic adoption initiatives.

 - Build activation experiences across email, in-app messaging, educational resources, community programming, and live learning.

 - Identify opportunities for proactive intervention and deeper adoption using customer and product data.

 - Define program-level success metrics and partner with Data on reporting that connects digital engagement to activation, adoption, and retention.

 - Use AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to streamline workflows, develop content, analyze insights, and improve program efficiency.

 - Build frontline awareness, buy-in, and enablement so partners can successfully adopt and support new programs.
   
   


HOW TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE

 - 5+ years of experience in customer-facing, lifecycle marketing, customer success, or program management roles, preferably in SaaS.

 - Experience designing, launching, and optimizing scalable onboarding, product activation, and customer engagement programs, ideally within a digital-first or scaled Customer Success model.

 - Strong understanding of the customer journey, product adoption, and retention levers, with experience using behavioral triggers and customer data to deliver targeted, personalized engagements.

 - Ability to analyze product usage and engagement data, measure program effectiveness, and continuously optimize for impact.

 - Strong project management skills, with a structured approach to defining goals, scope, milestones, and success metrics while independently driving cross-functional initiatives.

 - Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and customer-facing content development skills.

 - Proficiency with AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to improve workflows, accelerate execution, and drive operational efficiency.

 - Experience with Salesforce, Snowflake, Customer.io http://Customer.io, customer success platforms, or similar systems.

 - Exposure to customer education, community engagement, or content strategy.

 - Uses AI in day-to-day work to amplify their skills and strengthen their outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar.

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.



What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

 - Industry-competitive salary and equity

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

 - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

 - Health & wellness stipend

 - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

 - Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

 - Family planning benefits

 - Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

 - Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

 - 11 company-paid holidays

 - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

 - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

title: Client Success Manager
description:
Seven Figure SMP is a US-based marketing agency. Since 2020 we've served 200+ clients in the US, UK, Canada, Australia and Ireland. Most are scalp micropigmentation (SMP) and permanent makeup (PMU) clinics, plus hair restoration, aesthetics and other local service businesses.
 As our Client Success Manager, you own the client relationship from start to finish. You're the first point of contact for clinic owners. You run regular check-ins and coordinate our pod of media buyers, appointment setters, a CRM specialist and the creative team. You also spot clients who are ready to upgrade from Growth Mode to Scale Mode. This isn't a message-relay role. When a client's results move, you open the ad account, CRM pipeline or tracking yourself, find the cause, and come to the client with an answer and a plan.
 Requirements: at least 3 years in a client-facing agency role (account management or client success). At least 1 year hands-on in Meta Ads Manager (Google Ads is a plus). A solid grasp of lead-gen metrics (CPL, booked consults, show rate, cost per client). A track record of keeping clients. Excellent written and spoken English. You must be based in Canada and legally able to work there. Full-time, Monday–Friday, 8 AM–5 PM EST, fully dedicated (no freelancing).
 Pay: CAD $5,000–$7,000 a month base, set by experience. After your 90-day probation you also earn US$225/month for 3 months for each client you upgrade to Scale Mode, with no cap.
 Hiring process: application with a Loom video and the Culture Index survey, then a client and account scenario test, a team interview, and a final call with leadership. It usually takes 2–3 weeks.

title: Vice President of Customer Success
description:
Fotokite develops autonomous, high-endurance tethered unmanned aerial systems to help firefighters and public safety teams save lives.
 Fotokite systems allow first responders to quickly and easily gain situational awareness after arriving at emergency scenes: our autonomous one-touch launch/land system makes operation simple and safe; the dual color and thermal camera payload provides situational awareness from the system’s aerial perspective; and actively tethered flight means the system can be flown without a certified pilot, and can be left flying for as long as the situation requires.
 Fotokite is seeking a hands-on, high-impact Vice President of Customer Success to architect, build, and lead our global post-sales function from the ground up. Operating in a Player-Coach capacity, you will write the official Customer Success Playbook, implement the technical infrastructure and tracking tools, and directly manage key strategic accounts while scaling a high-performing team across North/South America and Europe.
 You will bridge hardware logistics, software telemetry, and customer retention to transform post-sale operations into a predictable, high-margin revenue engine across public safety agencies, defense entities, OEMs, and enterprise security clients.
 Key Responsibilities
 1. Playbook Architecture & Standard Operating Procedures
 Create the CS Playbook: Build the end-to-end Fotokite Customer Success Playbook from scratch, establishing standardized SOPs for Order Handoff, Technical Commissioning, Day 30 CSAT Audits, Day 90 QBRs, and Renewal Triggers.
 Scale Repeatable Processes: Codify segment-specific onboarding and expansion workflows tailored to Firefighting, Law Enforcement, Defense, and Enterprise Security verticals across global regions.
 2. Infrastructure, Tooling & Analytics Setup
 Build the CS Tech Stack: Select, configure, and roll out customer health tracking platforms (e.g., Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero, or advanced CRM modules) and integrate them with hardware telemetry logs.
 Establish Health Scoring & Dashboards: Develop real-time customer health dashboards tracking system flight hours, deployment frequency, software utilization, maintenance status, and churn risk indicators.
 3. "Player-Coach" Team Leadership & Account Execution
 Lead by Example (Player): Directly manage flagship enterprise, defense, and strategic municipal accounts; personally conduct high-stakes in-person QBRs, flight demos, and executive check-ins.
 Scale the Global Team (Coach): Recruit, mentor, and manage regional Customer Success Managers (CSMs) and Sales Engineers across the Americas and Europe, instilling a high-accountability, customer-centric culture.
 4. Revenue Ownership: Retention, Expansion & Software Attach
 Drive Account Expansion: Partner with Regional Sales Managers and Resellers to execute systematic fleet expansion campaigns, driving multi-unit orders and accessory upsells.
 Monetize Software & Support: Own post-sale revenue for annual software subscriptions, cloud data streaming, software maintenance, and extended warranty/service attachments.
 Key Qualifications
 Player-Coach Mindset: Proven willingness to roll up your sleeves, write documentation, configure software tools, and manage customer accounts directly while building executive strategy.
 Zero-to-One Infrastructure Builder: Direct experience selecting, setting up, and deploying CS tracking platforms, CRM health scoring, and customer telemetry dashboards from scratch.
 Author of CS Playbooks: Demonstrated track record creating formal, scalable Customer Success Playbooks and SOPs in a hybrid Hardware-plus-SaaS, IoT, Robotics, Defense, or GovTech environment.
 5+ Years CS Leadership: Proven leadership experience building and scaling CS teams.
 Revenue & P&L Accountability: Track record of direct ownership over gross retention, net expansion revenue, software attach rates, and service contract renewals
 We require that applicants already have permission to work in the US. We will not sponsor work-related visas now or in the future. Please include both a resume and cover letter. We are looking forward to hearing from you!
 ---
 Fotokite US LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, sexual orientation and expression, age, marital status, disability, religion, national origin, military service, arrest/conviction record, victims of domestic violence, and genetics.

Our core companion care model provides personalized, hyper-local support on a national scale, addressing the root social needs that impact a person's health and well-being. Papa Plus builds on this foundation by combining companion care with targeted quality programs to create a single, comprehensive benefit.
 Built on human connection and validated through millions of visits and dozens of studies, Papa ’s first-of-its-kind care model has been shown to improve member engagement, enhance quality of life, and contribute to more informed use of healthcare services—leading to lower costs and better health. We’re driven by our vision of aging better, together. Learn more at papa.com.
 About the Role:
 The Client Success Manager owns the day-to-day relationship for an assigned portfolio of health plan clients. As the client's primary point of contact, you'll make sure programs run smoothly, deliverables land on time, and clients feel supported and heard. You'll build trusted relationships with your client contacts, keep a close eye on program health, and partner with internal teams to solve problems quickly.
 This role is focused on strong execution and relationship management. You'll support implementations and launches for your accounts, manage reporting and contract deliverables, and resolve day-to-day client issues—escalating more complex or sensitive matters to Client Success leadership. You'll work closely with internal partners to monitor client health and performance.
 Successful candidates will be equally comfortable presenting to client stakeholders, digging into performance data, troubleshooting an operational issue, and bringing together teams to drive a solution.
 The overarching goal is simple: deliver exceptional client outcomes that drive retention and growth.

 Own day-to-day relationship management for an assigned portfolio of clients, serving as their primary point of contact and building trusted, long-term relationships.

 Support client implementations and launches, coordinating operational requirements and keep tasks on track.
 Lead recurring client meetings, executive business reviews, performance discussions, and other client communications.

 Support business reviews by pulling data, preparing materials, and highlighting key program results.
 Manage client complaints and requests for additional information, resolving issues directly where possible and escalating complex or sensitive issues appropriately.
 Manage client invoices and respond to billing inquiries.
 Ensure timely completion and coordination of client compliance/audit requests.
 Coordinate and manage care referrals for members, highlighting critical referrals to the client.
 Partner with internal teams to meet client deliverables, ensure continuity of support after go-live, and drive process improvements.
 Anticipate client needs and bring forward solutions to overcome obstacles.
 Meet or exceed client satisfaction and retention goals for your portfolio.

Combined, Instinct Science offers an ecosystem that veterinarians rely on for every aspect and stage of their careers.

The Customer Implementation Specialist works with onboarding leads, product teams, and customers to remove friction, solve setup challenges, and contributes to delivering a smooth go-live experience.

 Experience in data proficiency with practical experience in Excel or Google Sheets

title: Implementation Consultant - Functional
description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.
 We are seeking an Implementation Consultant (Functional/Project Lead) to lead the functional and project management work required to successfully deploy our SaaS platform for enterprise utility customers. This role is critical to ensuring structured, well-coordinated, and repeatable implementations for customers operating critical infrastructure.
 The Implementation Consultant serves as the functional owner of implementation workstreams, partnering closely with a dedicated Tech/Solution Consultant, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to deliver high-quality customer deployments. This role focuses on business process alignment, project coordination, and customer-facing enablement required to bring customers live — including requirements gathering, timeline management, stakeholder coordination, and functional configuration decisions (hazard/task libraries, templates, workflows, roles and permissions).
 This is a high-impact opportunity within a growing enterprise SaaS organization supporting the Utilities & Energy sector, where operational alignment, clear communication, and reliable project delivery are essential.
 Location: United States (Remote) with up to 50% travel
 Duties and Responsibilities:
 Implementation & Project Leadership 
 Lead the functional implementation workstream for enterprise customer deployments from kickoff through go-live, demonstrating accountability for delivery quality and outcomes
 Own the project timeline, task tracking, and coordination across internal teams and customer stakeholders
 Conduct discovery sessions to understand customer business processes, operational workflows, and organizational requirements
 Translate business requirements into functional configuration plans — hazard/task libraries, templates, workflows, roles and permissions
 Partner closely with the Tech/Solution Consultant to align functional decisions with technical implementation (integrations, SSO, data migration, environment setup)
 Lead regular customer checkpoints, status updates, and cross-functional alignment meetings
 Track and document implementation activities to support transparency, knowledge sharing, and repeatability
 Business Process & Configuration Design 
 Lead business process design workshops with customer stakeholders (Safety Managers, Ops Leads, Supervisors)
 Own configuration decisions related to forms, templates, hazard/control libraries, and workflow design
 Validate that configured workflows reflect real-world field operations and customer requirements
 Partner with SMEs to ensure the solution supports day-to-day operational needs
 Training, Adoption & Change Support 
 Support training planning and delivery, partnering with the Comms/Change Lead on rollout strategy
 Identify Field Champions and support their enablement ahead of Field Pilot
 Gather and incorporate field feedback during Pilot and early go-live into configuration adjustments
 Communicate new product releases and relevant feature updates to customers, helping them understand and adopt new capabilities as they become available
 Testing, Validation & Go-Live Readiness 
 Coordinate UAT planning and execution from a functional/business-process perspective
 Identify and communicate functional risks, dependencies, or blockers impacting launch readiness
 Support go-live cutover planning and ensure clean handoff to Customer Success and Support
 Scalable Implementation Practices 
 Identify recurring functional/configuration challenges and convert them into reusable templates and standard approaches
 Collaborate with Product to shape configuration tooling and platform enhancements based on field learnings
 Create documentation or toolsets that reduces manual effort and improves implementation velocity across future deployments
 Required Skills & Experience
 2+ years of experience in implementation consulting, project management, business analysis, or customer-facing SaaS deployment roles
 Proven experience leading project or functional workstreams for enterprise software implementations
 Ability to translate customer business requirements into scalable, well-documented configuration plans
 Strong project management skills — timeline management, stakeholder coordination, risk/dependency tracking
 Ability to collaborate effectively with a technical counterpart (Tech/Solution Consultant), customer stakeholders, and internal cross-functional teams
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to lead workshops and build stakeholder confidence and trust
 Preferred Skills & Experience
 Experience implementing software for utility, energy, industrial, or regulated enterprise customers
 Experience deploying software to field/frontline environments (mobile applications, operational or field-based platforms) is a plus
 Familiarity with change management or training rollout for operational teams
 Background in business process design, workflow configuration, or configuration-heavy SaaS platforms
 Experience with reporting or dashboards using SQL and visualization tools
 Physical Demands: No specific physical demands associated with this position.
 Benefits Info: 
 This position also includes a competitive benefit package including; financial, social, health and wellbeing programs, paid vacation, 401k matching, employee stock purchase program, hybrid work schedule, and more!
 Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. title: Development Operations Manager
description:
Women Donors Network (WDN) and its 501(c)(4) affiliate, Women Donors Action (WDA), are hiring a passionate and seasoned Development Operations Manager to build and manage the systems, data, and workflows that power our rapidly growing donor network and grantmaking organization. This role is for a CRM owner, systems builder, and data steward who takes pride in data integrity, reporting, and analytics. You’re energized by designing standards and tools that people actually adopt, and you understand that behind every record is a relationship. 
 This is a full-time, remote role based in the United States, with occasional travel. The Development Operations Manager reports to the Vice President of Community & Development and works closely with the Finance Team, the Technology Team, and external consultants. Grounded in a deep commitment to social justice, this role helps strengthen the leadership and effectiveness of a multiracial, multigenerational membership community of donor organizers.
 ABOUT US 
 Women Donors Network (WDN) is a national network of women (cis and trans), nonbinary, and gender-expansive individuals committed to protecting and advancing gender, racial, economic, and climate justice. As a growing multiracial and multigenerational community of donor organizers, we connect, grow, fund, and mobilize together in solidarity with movements to transform people, culture, and systems rooted in justice. Through Women Donors Action (WDA), our 501c4 affiliate organization, we work to transform policies, political infrastructure, and political possibilities by investing in advocacy and electoral strategies that center the leadership of historically excluded communities. Together, we envision a just and sustainable world where everyone can safely and freely determine their own futures. 
 This is an exciting time at WDN and WDA as we move into the fourth year of our bold strategic plan. We have a growing team passionate about social justice and motivated to scale our impact. Our values are rooted in a culture of courage, commitment, curiosity, accountability, hope, and joy. You can read more about our path forward here.
 We are a geographically distributed, remote team of 27 from diverse intersectional identities, including cisgender, BIPOC, and nonbinary people. We have a shared staffing structure across WDN and WDA, with our team dedicating a portion of time to each entity. We believe that a diverse team is integral to our work and strongly encourage applications from people of color, people with disabilities, women, LGBTQIA+, and all other applicants from historically excluded identities in the United States.
 ABOUT THE ROLE
 This is a pivotal moment for the Development Operations Manager to join the team at WDN/WDA. WDN/WDA is on track to steward $35M+ annually through a bespoke membership model where our members give at levels ranging from four to nine figures. As our membership community and grantmaking continue to grow, the Development Operations Manager will build and manage the development operations infrastructure our community, grantmaking, and organizations need to scale. 
 As Development Operations Manager at WDN/WDA, most of your time will focus on CRM management, data integrity, and analytics. You’ll own day-to-day use of Salesforce, set the data standards every team follows, and build the dashboards and reports that give senior leadership a clear view of fundraising progress, member engagement, and pipeline health. You’ll partner with the Head of Technology and external consultants on larger builds and platform decisions. Because WDN and WDA share a staffing structure, you’ll process and track gifts across both entities, and apply the distinct acknowledgment and compliance practices each entity requires. A smaller portion of your time will support member coordination, including onboarding, prospective member pipeline management, and engagement at Community & Development events.
 In 2027, we’re launching a network power mapping project to better understand the relationships and reach within our community. We see a significant opportunity to clean up and strengthen our donor data, and we’re exploring whether our current CRM will meet our needs as we scale. You’ll be at the center of all three efforts, turning our data into a trustworthy, shared resource that informs how we cultivate, steward, and engage members. 
 During your first year as the Development Operations Manager at WDN/WDA, you will:
 Lead a comprehensive cleanup of our donor and member data and establish clear standards to keep it clean, making Salesforce a trusted single source of truth.
 Build engagement tracking across member-facing teams, Board members, and member Ambassadors that supports WDN/WDA’s member engagement and retention strategy.
 Strengthen moves management in Salesforce, including stage definitions and pipeline review processes, so the team can track cultivation and solicitation consistently.
 Evaluate existing Salesforce fields and recommend updates that enable the CRM to serve as the repository for data from our forthcoming network power mapping project.
 Deliver dashboards that senior leadership relies on to understand fundraising progress, retention, and engagement.
 Help evaluate our CRM needs and, if we move forward with a migration, play a central role in planning and executing it.
 Create documentation and training that makes our systems easy to use correctly.
This is a remote position open to candidates based in the United States. Candidates must be available during weekday business hours across U.S. time zones and able to travel occasionally within the United States for meetings, team retreats, and organizational events. Candidates must have at least 5 years of development operations experience and demonstrated comfort with remote work. We are not accepting applications from outside the United States or from staffing agencies.

title: Logistic Operations Manager US
description:
About Hilo by Aktiia 
 High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 
 We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. 
 We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. 
 Role overview 
 Every Hilo Band that reaches a customer on time is one more person who can start taking control of their blood pressure. As Logistics Manager you own our day- to- day D2C logistics execution end to end: Webshop and Amazon across the USA and Canada markets. That covers daily fulfilment and outbound logistics, inbound transportation from our factories to regional warehouses, last mile delivery, returns, and the daily relationship with our 3PLs and carriers. Our network has grown to six third party logistics partners worldwide, including our newest partner in the US. Your impact comes from running the operation superbly well every day, resolving issues before customers feel them, and steadily making the flows you own smoother, faster and more cost efficient. You contribute to our wider logistics strategy, while overall network architecture sits with Operations leadership. You work as an individual contributor without direct reports, in close collaboration with Manufacturing, Finance, Sales, Quality and Customer Service, with room to grow as the network scales.
 Location: US-based, preferably East Coast, must be authorised to work in the United States, with regular traveling. The role requires minimum half-day working hours to overlap with our European-based team (CET), and travel to team and business events quarterly (or as needed). 
 Core responsibilities 
 End to end D2C logistics operations
 Own end to end D2C logistics for Webshop and Amazon across the USA and Canada.
 Run daily fulfilment and outbound logistics from order processing through final delivery, including last mile, returns and issue resolution.
 Resolve exceptions fast and cleanly so customers never feel the friction behind the scenes.
 Contribute to planning and implementing the overall logistics strategy.
 3PL and carrier management
 Manage and scale a multi 3PL network, including ramping up our newly launched US operation.
 Own SLAs, performance reviews and capacity planning across logistics partners.
 Be the daily operational contact for 3PLs and carriers, building relationships based on trust and clear expectations.
 Inbound and international transportation
 Own inbound transportation from our factories, for example in China and Vietnam, to regional warehouses.
 Lead inbound carrier selection, route design, rate negotiation and cost to serve optimisation.
 Coordinate freight booking, shipping schedules and handover to logistics partners.
 Manage customs clearance processes and import documentation.
 Product integrity and inventory execution
 Ensure product integrity for devices that are sensitive to temperature, humidity and pressure.
 Maintain inventory visibility across warehouses and sales channels.
 Coordinate replenishment to avoid both stockouts and excess inventory.
 Reporting and collaboration
 Define and track logistics KPIs such as OTIF, lead time, cost per shipment and return rate, and report them so the business can act on them.
 Drive continuous improvement of the operations you run.
 Collaborate closely with Manufacturing, Finance, Sales, Quality and Customer Service.
 Requirements
 Background & Experience
 Essential
 5+ years in logistics, fulfilment or supply chain operations, ideally in D2C or ecommerce and international distribution.
 Proven experience managing 3PLs, carriers and cross border shipments.
 Solid working knowledge of last mile delivery, Amazon fulfilment and international shipping fundamentals.
 Hands on experience with logistics or ERP tools, and strong analytical skills.
 Excellent English, written and spoken.
 USA based, and willing to travel occasionally to warehouses in Switzerland, Germany, UK, Canada, Australia and the USA.
 Nice to have
 BSc in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Logistics or a related field. Equivalent practical experience counts just as much.
 Chinese.
 Experience in medical device, pharmaceutical or other quality regulated logistics.
 Experience setting up logistics operations in a new market.
 How you work
 You are a self starter who thrives in a scale up without a large support structure around you.
 You have a strong execution mindset and real attention to detail.
 You keep several issues moving in parallel and prioritise well under pressure.
 You communicate clearly, take ownership and bring solutions rather than problems.
 What success looks like
 In your first 90 days
 Day 30 You know our network end to end: every 3PL, carrier, lane and system, and you are the go to person for daily operational questions.
 Day 60 You run daily fulfilment and inbound execution independently, you have taken over the 3PL and carrier relationships, and you have named the three biggest sources of friction in the current flow.
 Day 90 Logistics KPI reporting runs on your cadence, your first improvement is live and measurable, and you are driving the ramp up of our US operation.
 After one year
 Orders are fulfilled accurately and delivered on time, consistently and in Americas.
 Operational issues are identified early and resolved before customers are affected.
 Our US operation is running to SLA and scaling smoothly with demand.

title: Commercial & Operations Manager, Life Sciences Partnerships
description:
About Lighten 
 Lighten envisions a future where clinical data drives the next generation of breakthroughs in human health, from uncovering personalized treatment insights, to accelerating drug discovery, to driving adoption of innovative therapies.
 We build AI-native software platforms that transform raw clinical data into the highest-quality patient journeys, accelerating evidence generation for R&D and bringing life-saving therapies to market faster. We partner with life sciences and healthcare organizations to help them deliver on their mission for the patients they serve.
 We offer competitive salary and employee equity options, 3% company-sponsored 401k contributions, and comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance for employees and their families.
 About the role
 This is a unique role at the intersection of our executive team, commercial team, and clinical team. You’ll sit at the center of how Lighten wins and delivers: helping close deals on the commercial side while making sure what we sell is accurately translated into what our clinical team builds. It’s a front-row seat to how a high-growth life sciences AI company operates, with a clear path into a sales role or a Chief of Staff role as you grow.
 What you’ll do
 Partner with leadership. Work directly with the executive team and commercial team on pipeline, priorities, and cross-functional initiatives.
 Join the conversation. Participate in customer calls with pharma and life sciences clients, capturing needs, following up, and helping move opportunities forward.
 Draft proposals. Write and assemble proposals, scopes of work, and RFP responses that clearly communicate Lighten ’s approach, deliverables, and value.
 Keep deals on track. Maintain accurate tracking of opportunity status, next steps, and deadlines across the pipeline, and flag risks early.
 Translate client needs. Work with our clinical team to turn client requirements (cohort definitions, endpoints, data needs) into clear, actionable specifications, and relay clinical feedback back to the commercial team and client.
 Build the operating system. Improve our templates, processes, and internal playbooks so the commercial team can move faster and more consistently.
 What we’re looking for
 3-5 years of experience in a client-facing, operations, consulting, or analytical role, ideally in life sciences, healthcare, or health data/technology.
 Excellent written communication, with the ability to turn complex technical or clinical material into clear, persuasive proposals.
 Exceptional organization and follow-through, comfortable managing many moving pieces and deadlines at once.
 Comfort working with senior stakeholders, both internal executives and external clients.
 Curiosity and the ability to quickly learn clinical and data concepts well enough to bridge commercial and clinical teams.
 A self-starter mindset: you thrive in a fast-moving startup, take ownership, and figure things out without waiting to be told.
 Nice to have
 Background in epidemiology, biostatistics, public health, other scientific fields, clinical/medical training or consulting
 Working knowledge of EHR and claims data
 Exposure to life sciences commercial, RWE, HEOR, or medical affairs organizations
 Experience with CRM tools and proposal or RFP processes
